A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you install.

Is this an antivirus?

Sentinel is a behavioral detection research prototype. It flags unusual Linux process, file-open, and network activity. It does not scan files for viruses, identify malware families, or automatically quarantine anything.

Will it work on Windows 11?

You can run it inside Ubuntu on WSL 2 or a Linux virtual machine. It monitors the Linux environment, not Windows applications. A native Windows detector would need different collectors.

Do I need to collect new data?

No. The current model and recorded feature replay are included. More independent data would help evaluate and improve detection across different devices and workloads later.

What does live monitoring need?

A Linux kernel with BTF, the matching native CO-RE collectors, and administrator authorization for the fixed collector helper. See the installation guide. Passing prerequisite checks does not replace a live compatibility test.
